### [`scroll_step`](../../../../src/plane/plane_states.asm#L21) `$6E22`

*routine*

Moves the diagonal scroll one fine step: $400f += 2, $400e -= 2. After four steps it continues at scroll_next_row.
Mixes the random seed (see $4ad5).
